title: Spec2PR: How a Jira Ticket Became the Start of an Entire Delivery Pipeline
audience: Engineering leaders, delivery managers, and senior engineers working in multi-team environments
tone: Practical and systems-thinking — connecting planning artifacts to delivery intelligence
key_thesis: A Jira ticket is where engineering intent is first captured. It is also where most of that intent gets lost before it reaches implementation. The Spec2PR Jira analysis feature in the DevEx AI Assistant extension changes that — detecting whether a story spans multiple repositories, generating coordination plans with phases and dependencies, mapping service ownership, and creating the full implementation context before a single line of code is written.
